title.zh: ECB President Christine Lagarde to step down nine months early
title.en: ECB President Christine Lagarde to step down nine months early

current_state.zh: ECB President Christine Lagarde will step down on February 7, 2027, about nine months before her term ends, without explaining the reason, in a move that could let current European Council members help choose her successor before France's presidential election.
current_state.en: ECB President Christine Lagarde will step down on February 7, 2027, about nine months before her term ends, without explaining the reason, in a move that could let current European Council members help choose her successor before France's presidential election.
